# Xosist-Natural

Xosist-Natural converts a natural-language research intent into multiple high-quality X (Twitter) advanced search queries, and turns collected posts into readable natural-language summaries.

It does **not** call the X API and does **not** scrape X. It only generates official x.com/search URLs and processes text that the user (or agent) pastes in.

## Core capabilities

- composeQueries(intent, { noiseLevel }) → multi-angle search queries
- synthesize(posts, intent, { style }) → natural language report
- buildSynthesisPrompt(posts, intent) → prompt for external LLMs

## Free by design

All core planning and synthesis logic runs client-side or offline. No API key required for query generation or basic narrative synthesis.

## Discovery

- Human UI: index.html
- Agent entry: this file + AGENTS.md (planned)
- Tools: lib/query-composer.js, lib/synthesizer.js
